title: DENIED_PHRASES lacks 'webinar has ended' wording; ended page with a leftover canvas + overlay classifies in-call
detail:
Checker repro: html with

The webinar has ended

, a visible 900x500 canvas and a .sharee-container -> classify_admission('zoom') == 'in-call' (expected unknown). DENIED_PHRASES only has 'meeting has ended'/'meeting ended'. Modelled DOM only; live ended-page markup not captured.
fix_direction: add 'webinar has ended', 'webinar ended', 'webinar is over' to DENIED_PHRASES with a fixture.

title: Weak in-call signal (big video + name tag) fires on a pre-start 'webinar will begin shortly' page
detail: Repro: 'Hold on, the webinar will begin shortly' + 640x360 <video> + .video-avatar__avatar-footer -> 'in-call'. No lobby phrase matches. Also tag-removed mutation (return media) survives the suite: no fixture has visible media without a tag. Join guard 'input[placeholder*=name]' would also suppress true in-call if an in-call panel has such an input.
fix_direction: add webinar pre-start phrases to ZOOM_LOBBY_PHRASES; add visible-media-no-tag fixture.
